source.name: Maple Classic Guide by TokiLee
source.note: Routes summarised from the guide (levels 1-45, as of October 2026), with its maps matched to the game's map ids.

A.name: Route A
A.summary: Henesys, Kerning City, then Ellinia. More quests done along the way, so more mesos early; smaller, busier maps.

B.name: Route B
B.summary: Ellinia only: Slime Tree, Forest of Wisdom, Horny Mushroom Tree. Bigger maps and less travel; fewer quests.

stages.title: Maple Island
steps: Do the Maple Island quests on the way to A Split Road (skip Todd's hunting lesson if it's crowded).
Hunt at A Split Road to level 5.
At 5, do the quests in Amherst; get an Orange Mushroom Cap from the top right of The Field West of Amherst (or Dangerous Forest if it's crowded).
Back to A Split Road until level 8, then hand in Biggs's Collection of Items.
At 8, sail to Victoria Island.

stages.title: Thicket Around the Beach
steps: In Lith Harbor, pick up Olaf's First Training and Teo's Weird Hobby; finish both at Thicket Around the Beach I (1 Slime Bubble).
Pick up Olaf's Second Training and Teo's Even Weirder Hobby; finish them at Thicket Around the Beach II (1 Pig's Head).
Hunt at either Thicket until 10, collecting Squishy Liquid and Tree Branches for I'm Bored 2. Beginners lose no EXP on death, so dying is a free trip to town.
At 10, hand in Olaf's Second Training, Teo's Even Weirder Hobby and Phil's Call in Lith Harbor.
Then make your first job advancement, and pick a route.
Route A: pick up Don Hwang's Request (costs 1,000 mesos) and JM From tha Streetz Looking for a Partner in Kerning City.
Route B: pick up The Stump Horror Story and Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice in Perion.

A: JM From tha Streetz Looking for a Partner
B: Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice

stages.title: Mushroom Garden
steps: In Henesys, pick up The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies and Vicious in Need of an Apprentice (its branches are hard to get; this route doesn't finish it).
Hunt Orange Mushrooms at Mushroom Garden until 12.
pick up: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
Vicious in Need of an Apprentice

stages.title: The Rain-Forest East of Henesys
steps: Hunt Pigs here until 14.

stages.title: Errands: Henesys, Free Market, Perion, Kerning
steps: Hand in The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies.
Take the Citizenship quest: do To Henesys, the Prairie Town, then take To the Gray City, Kerning City.
In the Free Market, do the Welcome to the Free Market! questline.
In Perion, pick up The Stump Horror Story, Fixing Blackbull's House and Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice.
In Kerning City, hand in I'm Bored 1 and 2, Don Hwang's Request, JM From tha Streetz Looking for a Partner and To the Gray City, Kerning City; pick up Shumi's Request.
Do the citizen daily in the town you become a citizen of (Henesys citizens can do it in the next stage).
complete: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
To the Gray City, Kerning City
JM From tha Streetz Looking for a Partner
pick up: To the Gray City, Kerning City
Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice

stages.title: Caution Falling Down / Northern Top of Construction Site
steps: Hunt Blue Mushrooms and Stumps at either map until 20 (someone in the group needs to hit Blue Mushrooms reliably: at 14, archers, mages and DEX warriors can).
Northern Top of Construction Site also has Dark Stumps, for Leaf.
Get Pure Water and a Salad at Florina Beach (keep the Salad for Luke the Security Guy later).
At 18, pick up Alex's Request in Kerning City.

stages.title: Errands: Kerning, Lith Harbor, Perion, Henesys
steps: In Kerning City, hand Shumi's Request and Andre's Request in to Nella.
In Lith Harbor, pick up Jane and the Mushroom.
In Perion, hand in The Stump Horror Story, Fixing Blackbull's House and Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice.
In Henesys, hand in Alex's Request; pick up Talking to Stan, Pia and the Blue Mushroom and I Need to Find My Daughter, and do I Need to Find My Daughter with the return scrolls it gives.
Hunt more Blue Mushrooms (Kerning or The Blue Mushroom Forest) for the kill counts of Talking to Stan and Jane and the Mushroom.
Then go to Ellinia (ranged classes can go straight to Transfer Area instead).
complete: Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice
I Need to Find My Daughter

stages.title: Horny Mushroom Tree
steps: In Ellinia, pick up I Need Help on My Homework! and How to Enjoy Mushrooms (from Shane).
Hunt at Horny Mushroom Tree (Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North II) until 25; do How to Enjoy Mushrooms and How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More when you go back to restock.
Ranged classes can move to Transfer Area once they mostly one-shot Stirges; Damp Forest groups stay here until 25.
Hand in all the remaining quests.
complete: I Need Help on My Homework!
How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More

stages.title: Slime Tree
steps: Hunt Slimes at Slime Tree (Dungeon, Southern Forest I) until 14.
On the way there, collect Tree Branches and Leaves.
Hand in I Need Help on My Homework! once you have 10 Leaves, 10 Squishy Liquids and 3 Slime Bubbles.
complete: I Need Help on My Homework!

stages.title: Errands: Henesys, Free Market, Perion, Kerning
steps: Have 12 Squishy Liquids and 12 Tree Branches, and The Stump Horror Story ready to hand in.
Take the Citizenship quest: do To Henesys, the Prairie Town in Henesys, then take To the Gray City, Kerning City from Arthur.
In the Free Market, do the Welcome to the Free Market! questline (it ends in Perion).
In Perion, hand in The Stump Horror Story and Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice; pick up Fixing Blackbull's House.
In Kerning City, hand in To the Gray City, Kerning City, and hand in I'm Bored 1 and 2 to Icarus.
Become a citizen of Henesys or Kerning City and do the citizen daily. Keep 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leaves for the next stage.
complete: To the Gray City, Kerning City
Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice
pick up: To the Gray City, Kerning City

stages.title: The Forest of Wisdom
steps: Hunt at The Forest of Wisdom until 18-20.
When you restock, pick up How to Enjoy Mushrooms (and How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More) from Shane.
Hand in Fixing Blackbull's House once you have 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leaves.

stages.title: Horny Mushroom Tree
steps: From 18-20, hunt at Horny Mushroom Tree (Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North II) until 22-25.
Ranged classes can move to Transfer Area once they mostly one-shot Stirges; Damp Forest groups stay until 24-25.
STR Warriors coming early need the accuracy: more than level 5 Precise Strikes at 18 (Sniper Potions from Henesys or Perion help).

stages.title: Transfer Area (ranged classes)
steps: Hunt Stirges here until 35. Its spawn rate was cut to 0.7x, so it's busier than it was.
At 23, do Stranger's Request, then pick up Stranger's Identity for later.
With friends at Damp Forest, pick up Luke the Security Guy and do its Jr. Necki part (a Salad is sold at Florina Beach).
Do Kerning PQ at least once (for Proof of Companionship), ideally before level 31.

stages.title: Damp Forest (party of 4)
steps: Hunt here until 35 in a party of 4 (two at the bottom, one in the middle, one at the top). Going from Perion is fastest; Warrior Potions are sold there.
Collect Squishy Liquids, Octopus Legs and Leaves for Getting Arcon's Blood later.
Pick up Luke the Security Guy on the way; with friends at Transfer Area, also do the Stirge part of Stranger's Request, then pick up Stranger's Identity.
Do Kerning PQ at least once (for Proof of Companionship), ideally before level 31.

stages.title: Ant Tunnel I (if you one-shot Zombie Mushrooms)
steps: Only if you mostly one-shot Zombie Mushrooms; otherwise Transfer Area or Damp Forest is better.
First, pick up Maya of Henesys and do it up to Arcon's Blood?.
Hunt until 40-45; the upper middle and upper bottom are best. Ant Tunnel IV is an alternative (its middle spawns poorly).

stages.title: Land of Wild Boar (party of 4)
steps: Hunt until 40-45, best in a party of 4.
Less EXP than Ant Tunnel I's best spots, but more mesos from crafting-material drops.
